Ari (growth): heads-up: launch week plan. need final redirect CSV, webinar schema, and inbound routing for leads. who volunteers?
Nate (seo): i'll take redirects + quick internal-link checklist. which canonical for webinar replay? /launch/scale-2026 or /webinars/scale-2026/replay?
Rae (content): prefer /webinars/.../replay as the canonical for replay assets so it lives under resources. posts should link to it and to pillar pages.
Jordan (ops): ok i'll produce redirect CSV (from old promos + shortlinks) and push 301s. will share format `from,to,code,notes`. ETA today.
Ari (growth): keywords for posts: "predictable inference cost", "throughput-optimized serving", "production LLM routing". Rae please map H2s and anchor text.
MiniCrawler: quick-scan: 5 pages with 302s, 2 missing Event schema on replay candidates. report: https://redwood.ai/internal/seo/scan/2151230000
Nate (seo): schema snippet (Event + VideoObject) - small version to drop in CMS:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-07-10T17:00:00Z","performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Ari Kumar"}],"workExample":{"@type":"VideoObject","name":"Replay","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/scale-2026/replay"}}
```
Rae (content): will add speaker bios and CTA to download benchmark.
Jordan (ops): redirect CSV uploaded: https://redwood.ai/internal/ops/redirects/2151230000.csv
Ari (growth): inbound routing: webinars -> sdr-queue if utm_medium=email; posts -> product-nurture. Jordan please set HubSpot rules.
Jordan (ops): setting rules now; will confirm once live.
Nate (seo): i'll run preflight crawl after redirects applied and post any meta duplicates.
Ari (growth): perfect. small deliverables: redirect CSV live + schema in CMS + UTM rules by EOD. thanks! :rocket:
